# The Morning

> > Sri Lanka's leading English-language news portal delivering comprehensive coverage of national politics, economics, sports, and current affairs.

The Morning provides in-depth reporting on Sri Lankan political developments, economic policy including coverage of the Economic Surveillance Committee, sports including Sri Lanka Cricket governance, and regional affairs affecting the Middle East and South Asia. The publication offers both web-based news and digital ePaper subscription services for readers seeking authoritative journalism on Sri Lankan and international news.

## Key Topics

- Sri Lanka
- Sri Lankan Politics
- Economic News
- Current Affairs
- Economic Surveillance Committee
